line: This man just stepped into quicksand.
In movies, it swallows people whole. But in real life, that can't happen.
Quicksand is about twice as dense as your body, so you'll only sink to around your waist.
The real danger is getting stuck. Pulling one foot straight out takes about as much force as lifting a car.
So instead, he wiggles his legs, letting water seep in to loosen the sand.
Then he leans back, spreads out his weight, and slowly floats himself free.
